content.introduction: To build an investment portfolio in 2026, consider including a mix of stocks, bonds, real estate investment trusts, and commodities for diversification. For fixed-income exposure, you can invest in bond-focused ETFs available on XTB. Automate your investments to remove emotional decision-making, encourage consistency, and take advantage of dollar-cost averaging. Regularly review and rebalance your portfolio once or twice a year to stay aligned with your goals and market conditions. For a firm foundation, consider starting with an S&P 500 ETF and supplementing with other assets. Maintain your portfolio by periodically checking it, even if you prefer a hands-off approach, and focus on high-quality assets like dividend stocks for compounding benefits.

Consider including a mix of stocks, bonds, real estate investment trusts , and commodities. For example, allocate to blue-chip stocks for stability, government bonds for safety, and REITs for income diversification. Additionally, consider including precious metals like gold to hedge against inflation.

### How can I effectively diversify my investment portfolio? [...] ## FAQ

### What are the key steps to creating a modern investment portfolio for beginners?

Define your financial goals, assess your risk tolerance, and choose a suitable asset allocation (e.g., 60% equities, 30% bonds, 10% cash). Use low-cost index funds or ETFs for diversification. Regularly review and rebalance your portfolio to align with changing goals and market conditions.

### How does risk tolerance affect my investment choices? [...] Investing may appear daunting for those just starting, given the abundance of information available. This guide aims to offer straightforward steps and useful tips for building your investment portfolio in 2026. You will explore various types of investments and formulate a long-term strategy, enabling you to make informed decisions that align with your financial aspirations.
